defects.evidence: The carrier-scorecard bullet states a responsibility but gives no result.
The intake-process bullet uses passive wording and gives no measure of the form reduction or resulting benefit.
The pickup-slot fill-rate change is incorrectly described as a 20% increase rather than a 20-percentage-point increase.
The weekly-active-user increase is mathematically misstated: growth from 400 to 1,150 is a 187.5% increase, not a 150% increase.
The chargeback-roadmap bullet leads with a long method list and leaves the loss analysis too vague to judge.
the long list of rollout, SOP, training and negotiation actions also makes it unclear which action produced the 1,800-hour saving.
Session-level randomization identifies a session-level conversion effect, not automatically a causal effect on unique customers, because one customer can contribute sessions to both groups.
In standard RICE, Reach estimates the number of users... Support tickets are a support-volume or impact proxy, so the current wording can make the prioritization method look technically incorrect.
Coastal Marine Services looks like an unexplained post-MBA pivot in the current presentation.
Within EXPERIENCE, the current order is not reverse chronological
